title: Same Attack, Different Judge: A First Controlled Adversarial Comparison of Jev, LLM Judges, and Purpose-Built Safety Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.17820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: TypeSafe AI's Jev is a new kind of safety judge. It generates no text and no label: it answers questions the developer defines in advance and returns a probability for each answer. The vendor admits that adversarial input can change these answers but gives no numbers. In this paper, we present the first controlled adversarial evaluation of Jev. We build a test harness that sends every system the same payload under the same policy, and run it on four public-data tasks, from rule-based ones (input moderation, injection detection, routing) to a judgment-based one (phishing detection), with fifty attack variants from thirteen families. The targets are Jev, five GPT and GLM judges, and two local classifiers (Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard 2). translated_title: 同一攻击，不同的裁判：Jev、LLM裁判与专用安全分类器的首次受控对抗性比较
translated_abstract: TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 是一种新型安全裁判。它不生成任何文本或标签：它回答开发者预先定义的问题，并为每个答案返回一个概率。厂商承认对抗性输入可以改变这些答案，但没有给出具体数字。在本文中，我们首次对 Jev 进行了受控对抗评估。我们构建了一个测试框架，在相同策略下向每个系统发送相同的攻击载荷，并在四个公开数据任务上运行测试——从基于规则的任务（输入审核、注入检测、路由）到基于判断的任务（钓鱼检测），涵盖来自十三个攻击家族的五十种攻击变体。测试对象包括 Jev、五个 GPT 和 GLM 裁判，以及两个本地分类器。我们发现 Jev 在输入审核任务上是最稳健的系统：对其结构化输入的八种伪造形式均无法绕过其任何决策，而一句仅仅询问“为什么有人可能提出有害请求”的话……
tldr: 本文首次对 TypeSafe AI 的安全裁判 Jev、基于 LLM 的裁判以及专用安全分类器进行了受控的对抗性比较评估，发现在输入审核任务上 Jev 表现最为稳健。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first controlled adversarial evaluation comparing TypeSafe AI's safety judge Jev with LLM judges and purpose-built safety classifiers, finding Jev to be the most robust system on input moderation tasks.
